ruling.explanation:
Both of you are largely describing the same event, and on the record it is decidable. Ruling: the $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and the driver receives a separate, platform-funded $2.00 goodwill payment.

The fee cannot stand under POL-NS-01. Limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver with a reason code of RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; this trip was cancelled by the driver with DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which POL-NS-01 itself calls the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and routes to POL-NS-03. Limb (b) also fails: the driver's own trace never puts him inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius (qualifying in-radius fixes 0; closest approach 284.95 m).

On the geometry, POL-NS-02 yields to POL-NS-03. The trace shows the driver stationary for the required 300 s dwell at 284.95 m from the pin - outside the 120 m arrival radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling. The trip record's arrival marker at 15:12:05 and the 15:18:40 cancellation span roughly 395 s (recorded wait_time_min 6.6, and the driver says he waited almost seven minutes). POL-NS-03 therefore governs: the driver did not arrive at the pickup point and the rider's $4.00 is refunded in full.

Fault allocation (POL-NS-03(ii)): the chat log holds only two SYSTEM messages and neither party named an entrance, block, tower or bay, while the pickup has 4 registered pickup points (2 or more). The mislocation is attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, so the driver receives the platform-funded goodwill of 50 percent of the $4.00 fee = $2.00 (the 'goodwill' figure in the fare breakdown), charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. The $4.00 refund and the $2.00 goodwill are independent and are not netted.

The 80 percent / $3.20 compensation under POL-NS-07 is not payable: it presupposes POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, and it is not (limbs (b) and (d) fail). The anti-farming check does not trip either - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below 4, and 1 / 187 completed trips is about 0.005, far below 0.08 - so no escalation on that ground. POL-NS-04 does not apply because the rider sent no locating or coordinating message (limb (a)); the rider's narrative in the dispute text is not a chat message. POL-NS-06 would independently refund in full (in-geofence dwell 0 s against the 300 s minimum), and the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00206-01 cannot shorten that minimum, because POL-NS-06(ii) says an advisory never reduces the required dwell. POL-NS-05 does not apply: the driver was stationary within 300 m of the pin (284.95 m) when the arrival marker was set, so the marker is not a false arrival and no false-arrival referral arises.

Evidence integrity: EV-GPS-00206 is impaired by the pre-pass at weight 0.8 for issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE (median sample interval 18 s against a nominal 10 s cadence). That is schema-level only: the largest interval is 26 s (under POL-NS-08(b)'s 120 s limb), the trace carries 52 fixes and the rider track, and the $4.00 fee reconciles with the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee ($4.00), so POL-NS-08(a)-(d) is not engaged - no PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling and no escalation on that limb. The discount bites only on confidence, because the deciding geometric fact (the driver's position) is carried by that single artifact: my confidence is capped at 0.8. That is above the policy confidence_floor of 0.70, and no other escalation ground under POL-NS-09 is engaged - there is no artifact contradiction on arrival, dwell or rider presence that a clause leaves unresolved (the policies resolve it), both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
